text:
elaine: Quick heads-up: I'm opening a docs PR to add an "audit playback" section that shows how to replay exported audit logs locally for debugging (with redaction examples). Need short SDK snippets incl. a Ruby sample and legal-approved retention phrasing.

maria: Nice. Playback will be helpful for support. Can you include a small CLI example and a jq filter to show redacted fields?

elaine: Yep. Draft CLI -> `redwoodctl audit replay --file export.json --start 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z` and jq sanity: `jq '.items[] | {ts:.timestamp, cat:.audit_event.category, user: .request.user_id // "<redacted>"}' export.json`

sanjay: I'll add Ruby snippet (rare for us, good catch). Also putting in a migration note: event_type -> audit_event.category.

jen: Legal wants retention line phrased as: "Retention is configurable per customer account; by default audit records are retained for 90 days. Exported audit records will be retained only when required by applicable law or legal process." Please use that exact sentence and swap any "customer" -> "customer account".

maria: Also include an explicit example showing a redaction rule (PII removal) in the JSON sample: e.g., "request": {"user_email": "<redacted>", "user_id": null}. Support asked for a note that redaction happens at export time.

elaine: I'll add a short Ruby snippet and a one-line Go/Node example for parity. Ruby draft:
```ruby
# ruby: basic audit list
res = client.audit.list(from: iso_from, to: iso_to, retention_hint: '90d')
puts res.items.count
```

maria: Can you also add a short blurb about tenant separation and that exports are scoped to customer account by default? That reduces confusion.

elaine: Added that line in the draft.

docs-bot: PR #5140 created by elaine: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5140 :sparkles:

jen: I'll do a quick legal sweep tonight; if wording and "customer account" swap are present I can approve.

elaine: Great — merging after QA and legal. Tagging @sre for export-agent bump coordination. :+1:
